correctness.rationale: Verified the exact orbit/occupancy characterization from original extendible perfect matchings. Every star intersection is the star of a simultaneously admissible spoke simplex, hence a nonempty cone. Faces outside their union are precisely complete cycle-dimer tilings: none for odd n, exactly two disjoint top simplices with boundaries in the core for even n≥4. The zero-dimensional n=2 case was proved directly. Cofibration attachment to contractible core yields exactly two spheres of dimension n/2−1. Finite independent enumeration n=2..8 (1,966 fixed orbit faces) and reduced mod-two ranks match the general proof; finite checks are not the argument for all n. The Smith corollary uses the independently published ambient homotopy theorem, not computational extrapolation.

value.rationale: An infinite natural family exhibits sharply different fixed-space homotopy types by parity (contractible for odd n; two spheres of unbounded dimension for even n). The complete geometric fixed-space type is stronger than previously known rational homological symmetry characters and gives a natural all-width sharpness family for Smith mod-two Betti inequality; no arbitrary parameter slice or mere normalization is involved.
